Current priorities (7/23)

First maximize the ×8/×10 Catch XP from the anniversary Ultra Unlock, then reserve route and Bag space for the 7/26 global raid make-up; see “Current Raid Counters” for complete boss lineups and moves.

Today through 7/27

  • Tonight’s Eevee Spotlight Hour offers ×2 Catch Candy; the anniversary event enters its ×10 Catch XP stage after 7/25 at 10:00, so level-focused Trainers should concentrate Lucky Eggs and high-XP throws in the final stage.
  • Against the current 5★ Solgaleo, prioritize Dark-, Fire-, Ghost-, or Ground-type damage; Mega Salamence is double weak to Ice, while Max Trubbish calls for Ground- or Psychic-type Max attackers.
  • Complete Ozone Ascent on 7/25–26 to secure the Meteorite first; the 7/26 raid make-up offers up to 12 free Raid Passes, making Mega Mewtwo Y and the time-blocked high-tier lineup better priorities for organized groups.

8/1 and hatch week

  • 8/1 Gigantamax Rillaboom: level up Fire- or Flying-type Max Moves in advance and assign tank and healer roles; the event lasts only from 14:00–17:00.
  • During Summer Marathon on 8/4–10, target Snom’s Shiny debut and other boosted-Shiny targets; clear Egg slots before Fire and Ice Hatch Day on 8/8. The half Hatch Distance does not stack with a similar Pass bonus, so there is no need to invest twice.
  • The 8/10 Beldum Max week is a useful opportunity to strengthen Steel-type Max damage; choose the later Magikarp, Hitmontop, and Eevee rotations according to your resource gaps.

Community Day and the dual window on 8/22

  • 8/16 Nickit Community Day: focus on Stardust, Candy, and Candy XL from 14:00–17:00; evolve by 21:00 to obtain the featured move Icy Wind.
  • Ultra Unlock: Water Festival raises XP and Stardust in stages from 8/18–24, reaching its highest stage on 8/22; then switch to Starmie Super Mega Raid Day from 11:00–17:00, prioritize free Raid Passes, and prepare Dark- and Ghost-type attackers.
  • Details for the 8/25–30 World Championships event have not yet been announced; preserve resources instead of making heavy investments around an unconfirmed lineup.
